fragment.choose:
<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiAuditEnabled", "false") == "true" && context.Variables.ContainsKey("piiMappings"))">
            @{
                var categories = new JObject();
                int count = 0;
                try
                {
                    // Placeholders look like  (pii-anonymization): count them per category.
                    foreach (var mapping in JArray.Parse(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiMappings", "[]")))
                    {
                        var placeholder = mapping["placeholder"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                        var category = placeholder.Trim('<', '>');
                        var cut = category.LastIndexOf('_');
                        category = cut > 0 ? category.Substring(0, cut) : category;
                        categories[category] = (categories[category]?.Value() ?? 0) + 1;
                        count++;
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception) { }
                return new JObject(
                    new JProperty("id", "pii-" + context.RequestId.ToString()),
                    new JProperty("timestamp", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")),
                    new JProperty("type", "PII_Audit"),
                    new JProperty("productName", context.Product?.Name ?? "NA"),
                    new JProperty("productId", context.Product?.Id ?? "NA"),
                    new JProperty("subscriptionId", context.Subscription?.Id ?? "NA"),
                    new JProperty("apiId", context.Api?.Id ?? "NA"),
                    new JProperty("operationId", context.Operation?.Id ?? "NA"),
                    new JProperty("model", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestedModel", "NA")),
                    new JProperty("entityCount", count),
                    new JProperty("entityCategories", categories),
                    new JProperty("confidenceThreshold", context.Variables.ContainsKey("piiConfidenceThreshold") ? Convert.ToDouble(context.Variables["piiConfidenceThreshold"]) : 0.0),
                    new JProperty("categoryExclusions", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiEntityCategoryExclusions", "")),
                    new JProperty("analysisFailure", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiAnalysisFailureReason", "")),
                    new JProperty("deanonymized", context.Variables.ContainsKey("piiDeanonymizedContentOutput")),
                    new JProperty("blocked", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiBlocked", "false") == "true"),
                    new JProperty("statusCode", context.Variables.ContainsKey("usageEventStatus") ? Convert.ToInt32(context.Variables["usageEventStatus"]) : (context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 0))
                ).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
            }
